title: Internal Hom from a coherent module into an injective module is flasque
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]), let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\mathcal I$ be an injective $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then the underlying sheaf of abelian groups of $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal I)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom] is flasque on the Zariski topological space of $X$ [def-sc-zariski-flasque].

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma 01EA (cohomology-lemma-injective-restriction-surjective: injectives are flasque; the same argument with the extension by zero of F|_U gives the sheaf Hom case), as used in the proof of Lemma 0FZ3 (1) via the local-to-global Ext spectral sequence

proof.text: For an open V, a section of internal Hom is a morphism F|_V → I|_V. Use the canonical extension-by-zero adjunction with its component formula, lem-weil-pbc-module-extension-by-zero-hom-formula, to identify this morphism with ψ : j_!(F|_V) → I.

Construct the presheaf map j_{p!}(F|_V) → F by the identity on each direct-sum summand. Naturality is checked on generators. For any open W the index set Hom(W,V) is a subsingleton. If it is inhabited, the direct-sum injection at its unique element is a left inverse to the component map; if empty, the source is zero. Thus the map is monic sectionwise and hence as a presheaf morphism. Sheafification preserves monomorphisms. Its adjoint map c : j_!(F|_V) → F factors as sheafification of this monomorphism followed by the invertible sheafification counit, so c is monic.

Injectivity of I extends ψ along c to g : F → I. The component formula identifies the adjunction image of c with the identity of F|_V, since the presheaf map sends every direct-sum injection to its section. Naturality in the target of the adjunction now gives g|_V equal to the original local morphism.

For V ⊆ U, restrict the global g to U. The internal-Hom restriction formula restrictOverMap_restrictOver_map identifies its restriction to V with g|_V. Hence every restriction map on internal Hom is surjective; AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective makes these maps epimorphisms, proving flasqueness.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 01EA proof, specialized to extending Hom sections to the whole space; monicity checked on presheaf sections and preserved by Mathlib module sheafification.
